title: The factory's status: .private/work/factory/status.json
description: Contract (PR f0) for the one file `scripts/factory/watch.py` (producer, PR f3) writes and `scripts/factory/statusline.mjs` (PR f8) and the `vextrus-factory` mod's band (`tools/mod/vextrus-factory/`, PR f8) read (docs/specs/factory.md 2.2 'Watch', 3.5 'Status line', 4 (b)). WRITE: watch.py rewrites the whole file every pass (60 s) atomically: it writes `status.json.tmp` in the same folder and renames it over `status.json`, so a reader never sees half a file. READ: a consumer reads the file whole, ignores nothing it needs, and never calls a process (the mod makes no `$.process.run` calls). AGE: a consumer computes `status n min old` as now minus `written_at`; when that is over 180 seconds, or the file is missing or does not parse, it prints WATCHER DOWN and still prints the clock. Every number is a count, a size or a time: no free text from a drawing, a diff or a builder's report ever enters this file (the leak wall: spec 5). `additionalProperties` is false on purpose: a producer that adds a field changes this schema and `status.sample.json` first, and every consumer's test reads the sample.

schema_version.description: Raised only by a breaking change; a consumer that sees another value prints WATCHER DOWN with 'status schema' and the clock.

written_at.description: UTC time this pass finished writing. The only source of 'status n min old'.

clock.description: From .private/work/factory/session.json (`stamp start`), the same source the clock hook prints. A consumer shows the clock UTC time from its own clock, never from this file.

session.description: null when no `stamp start` has run ('no budget set').

phase.description: null when the session has no current phase. The band's '3h12/5h30' is the phase when present, else the session.

resources.description: The band's 'disk 61G swap 0.0G avail 14G'. Gigabytes of 1024^3 bytes, one decimal place at most. null when the reading failed this pass (a consumer prints '?').

disk_free_gb.description: `df` free space of the repository's filesystem.

lock.description: The real-drawing lock's queue, as scripts/factory/rdlock.py keeps it in .private/work/factory/rdlock.json (holder, waiters, head, kind, since). When rdlock is cut (tier 2) the watcher reads the session flock: holder is then {kind, ticket: null, head: null} and waiters is [] if the waiters are not visible. The band's 'lock: post t228 14m (+2 waiting)'.

holder.description: null when the lock is free.

waiters.description: In queue order: posting first, then scored, then no-post, first in first out within each kind (spec 2.2 'Real-drawing lock').

builders.description: Builders by state: 'cloud 4 working, 1 READY, 1 quiet 31m · local 1'. The counts are the producer's tally of `items` (every item counts once, by `where` and `state`), so a consumer may use either.

reviews.description: Open review rounds: 'reviews #250 r1, #251 r2'. A PR appears once, at its newest open round, from the ledger folder (.private/work/factory/ledger/) and the PR's open state; a PR whose ledger holds a PASS for its current head is not open.

head.description: The head the round reviewed; null if not yet known.

g1.description: The G1 real-set walk's state on main, from .private/work/walks/<sha40>/verdict.json (walk-verdict.schema.json) and the live pidfile of a running walk.

main.description: null when no walk of main has ever run. The band's 'G1 main: FAIL ca2e1c4' prints the first 7 characters of `sha`.

usage.description: The last good `claude -p "/usage"` reading (every 15 min, spec 2.3). null when never read or when the text could not be parsed (the governor then fails closed; the status line says nothing about usage).

alarms.description: The alarms the watcher currently holds (spec 2.2 'Watch'); an alarm is dropped when its cause clears. The status line shows the count and the newest `code`.

code.description: BUILDER-QUIET: a cloud builder with no push for 30 min. BUILDER-BLOCKED: a local builder `blocked`. LOCAL-IDLE: a local builder whose `claude agents` row has read `status: idle` for 10 min after a commit, its head neither READY nor BLOCKED. READY-NO-VERIFY: a malformed READY head (no Factory-Verify matching its tree, a READY-looking line outside the factory trailers) or a factory trailer not in the read paragraph (trailers.md 1). READY-WAITING: a READY head waiting 10 min. NEW-CLAUDE-BRANCH: any new claude/* branch on origin. LEAK-HIT: a leak-scan hit on a cloud head. BUDGET-PASSED: a ticket's or the session's budget passed. FLOOR-CROSSED: a governor floor (disk, memory, swap, usage) crossed. REVIEW-READY: a cloud review verdict branch appeared (tier 2). JEV-MODEL-MOVED: `jev models-check` saw the model move (tier 2).

subject.description: The ticket, branch, PR (`#250`) or floor name the alarm is about; null for a session-wide alarm.

detail.description: One line in public words, counts and names only. Never drawing text, a diff line or a leak-scan hit's text (a LEAK-HIT's detail is `file:line` and a count).

utc.description: UTC to the second, with a literal Z (the form `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` prints).

lockKind.description: post: a posting run; scored: a scored run; no-post: a `--no-post` run. Priority post > scored > no-post.

since.description: When the entry joined the queue (a waiter) or took the lock (the holder).

builderState.description: A cloud builder is working (a push within the last 30 min or no push yet and young), ready (its newest head carries Factory-State: READY), blocked (BLOCKED), quiet (no push for 30 min or more and not ready or blocked) or done (its PR merged or closed). A local builder's state is `claude agents --json --all`'s `state` (working, blocked, done, failed, stopped), except that a head carrying READY shows ready.

quiet_max_minutes.description: The longest quiet time among this group's quiet builders ('1 quiet 31m'); null when none is quiet.

head.description: The branch tip the watcher last fetched; null before the first push.

last_push_at.description: When the tip last changed, as the watcher saw it.

quiet_minutes.description: Minutes since `last_push_at` for a cloud builder; null for a local builder.

state.description: The newest walk of main: its verdict.json result, or RUNNING while its pidfile names a live run.

at.description: When the walk finished (RUNNING: when it started).
